source_anchors.contains: The pending-payload descriptor/location owner creates that registration at the
query source. It remains the pack-read ledger only.
// `Unseen` answer remains a lawful direct source and keeps observing future
// It is not a second residency table and is cleared only by destructive
final class SourcePlanDeclaration(p: RouteASkeletonParameters) extends Bundle {

source_facts.creation: normative MR-1B: at accepted pending maturity; delivery deadline or end-of-registration signal absent
source_facts.producer: no concrete freeze/seal descriptor producer in current production top; input is external
source_facts.owner: once per reset; leaseLive no normal terminal clear input
source_facts.withdrawal: Valid-only mirror of true R3-to-R6 fire; does not backpressure authority
source_facts.plan_failure_gap: TransitionedPacked blocks pending association query without a negative response; v2 controller is after completion_plan and cannot discover this waiting preplan
source_facts.unbound_direct: R3 is not a directory for every lawful pending source; excluding those is not authorized

new_contract_assumptions.producer_cut: immutable complete group census plus no future generation, all offers accepted or exact-rejected with ACK before producer seal
new_contract_assumptions.token: namespace32 + monotonically allocated group sequence32, bound to real member/pending ownership
new_contract_assumptions.DUT_cut: all real R6 transitions, query results accepted, permanent owner facts retained or fully drained, readiness/notice custody, both close ACKs
new_contract_assumptions.live_service: bounded K=1 independent old context may survive journal reuse; never recycle/cancel issued lease on journal close
new_contract_assumptions.late_request: closed/stale/foreign-token/member explicitly rejected, never treated as Unseen
new_contract_assumptions.plan_cut: local rejection without an accepted attention; R6 preplan fault for accepted unplanned attention; original cancel chain after plan acceptance; existing lease continues after issue

capacity_argument: Single active <=64 group, injective ordinal writes, clear only after seals/custody/queries and close ACKs, no old-token Unseen afterward; bounded independent K contexts are separate nonzero costs.

implementation_gates.requirement: real producer finite queue and immutable creation/delivery cut including held valid offers and selected source obligations
bind current token to real maturity/member facts; reject relabelled old binding
independent live/pending proof and bounded cost for lawful unbound direct sources
closed negative response and exact R6 preplan fault path, no invented terminal
context custody/recycle with real cancel/abort/typed terminal/consumer/source release and retirement
source/queue/mux/query/ACK ports, timing and complete storage/service cost

assumptions: producer creates descriptor once at maturity, freezes generation and acknowledges all offered dispositions before seal
single <=64-member working group, no G1 admission before both close ACKs
all old queries resolve and permanent revoked facts remain in bounded independent owners
active token is bound to immutable pending/member ownership, not trusted solely from request bits
all accepted unplanned attentions have an explicit R6-owned rejection path; the lease component starts after association acceptance
the successful consumer/source-release branch uses one source-ending direct record; source_last is not derived from group size
owner custody ACK does not recycle or cancel an issued read
closed/wrong-namespace requests explicitly reject, never become Unseen

cancel_issued_lease.invariant: issued read was canceled/unpinned before matching typed terminal

clear_ignores_query.invariant: accepted unsnapshotted lookup still depends on cleared journal

closed_token_as_Unseen.invariant: closed history must not be reported as Unseen

foreign_key_relabelled_as_current_window.invariant: a current token alone cannot establish immutable member ownership
trace: old binding relabelled with G1 token

invent_terminal_without_accepted_attenti.invariant: a local registration rejection cannot invent an attention terminal

late_reply_revives_pending.invariant: late Unseen/Pending reply resurrects pending eligibility

open_after_one_ACK.invariant: G1 opens before both independent old-group close ACKs

reuse_owner_on_journal_clear.invariant: journal release overwrote a live service/cancel/query context

seal_ignores_offer.invariant: producer seal lies about outstanding creation/offer/disposition

trust_cached_eligibility.invariant: cached eligibility overrode real authority/commit-edge recheck
